messages:
elaine_sales: Quick sync on AcmeRetail POC — they asked for a few things we need to confirm before we hand off to SEs:
- DPA + SOC2 Type II artifacts
- PEN test attestation or schedule
- HIPAA/GDPR notes + data residency options
- Success criteria + eval prompt set and timeline

Can we align on what we can deliver within a 3-week POC window?
messages_2:
sam_solutions: @elaine_sales I can own the technical scoping + evals. Suggested split:
1) Security docs: raj to confirm what we can share and timeline
2) POC success criteria: define 3 concrete flows + pass/fail metrics
3) Pricing ask: include Dedicated trial pricing vs hosted usage estimate

Sample success criteria: <50ms p50 latency for 90% of requests, embedding MRR recall >= 0.85 on eval set, zero data exfil tests fail.
messages_3:
raj_security: We can provide:
- Standard DPA (editable) — 1 business day
- SOC2 Type II summary + auditor letter (redacted) — 2 business days
- Pen-test: we don't run a new full pen-test for POC customers. We can provide the latest internal pen-test report + vulnerability management summary. If they need a 3rd-party attestation, we can schedule but it takes ~4 weeks.

HIPAA/GDPR: we support business associate agreement (BAA) and Data Processing Addendum; encryption at rest/in transit, customer-managed KMS options for Private. Data residency: EU region options for GDPR, US-only regions for HIPAA.
messages_4:
amanda_eng: On the engineering side I can prepare a small eval harness and 3 route configs:
- Route A: short Q&A (seq len 256) — low latency
- Route B: context-heavy summarization (seq len 2k) — throughput test
- Route C: embedding + rerank pipeline

I'll push a sample prompt set and a `curl` example for streaming. ETA: 48h.
messages_5:
sam_solutions: Adding example eval prompts (will expand in repo):
```
# short Q&A
User: "What is the return policy for order #12345?"
Expected: mention timeframe + link to returns guide

# summarization
Input: 5 emails thread about order delay
Expected: short paragraph with root cause + next steps

# embedding recall
Queries: 50 product-related questions
Metric: top-3 recall >= 0.85
```

We should ask Acme to provide 50-100 probe prompts and 2 labeled golden answers per flow.
messages_6: elaine_sales: Pricing question from customer: they want a 2-week Dedicated trial vs hosted credits. Can we offer 2-week Dedicated at a reduced rate or trial bucket? Also they asked: will Dedicated trial include burst to handle spike day?
messages_7: raj_security: For Dedicated trial we usually do a limited reserved capacity with a trial discount — legal needs to approve but ops can enable burst policy (configurable) for the trial. Need to confirm resource availability in the target region. If they want on-prem Private trial, that needs infra planning and longer lead time.
messages_8: amanda_eng: Ops note: we can stand up a small Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) in eu-west-1 for 2 weeks. Burst to 4 GPUs is possible but we need an ops window to enable. I'll add a playbook with steps and runbook.
messages_9:
elaine_sales: Great. Next actions:
- @raj_security share DPA + SOC2 artifacts (1-2 days)
- @amanda_eng deliver eval harness + example prompts (48h)
- @sam_solutions draft success criteria doc and ask Acme for probe prompts (today)
- I'll confirm Dedicated trial pricing and get legal pre-approval for BAA

Can everyone confirm ETA?
messages_10: raj_security: Confirmed — I'll drop the docs into the secure folder and DM legal to review the BAA. If Acme insists on a fresh 3rd-party pen-test, we escalate to sales ops for budgeting.
messages_11: sam_solutions: Confirmed. I'll create the success criteria doc and sample eval spreadsheet and link it in thread when ready.
messages_12: amanda_eng: Confirmed. Will also include a small `curl` for streaming and a `kv-cache` config example so they can reproduce latency numbers.
messages_13: devops_bot: Deployment scheduled: Dedicated pool 'acme-retail-poc' will be provisioned in eu-west-1 on 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC (ETA 2h). Owner: amanda_eng
messages_14:
elaine_sales: Perfect — I'll update Acme and propose timeline:
Week 0: legal + security docs exchange
Week 1: Dedicated pool up, eval harness + prompt collection
Week 2: run evals, tweak configs
Week 3: joint review + handoff

Thanks team :raised_hands: — I'll loop in AE and customer success once docs are posted.
